svg.text: The aggregation problem: percentiles do not add up

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: 10 instances each report p99 = 200ms. Averaging gives 200ms - and is wrong. The math demands aggregating buckets

svg.text: X The wrong way: average the pre-computed percentiles

svg.text: avg(p99) = 200ms <- this is just the average of averages, not the global p99

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

svg.text: Real global p99 is somewhere between 200ms and ... unknown. The slowest 1% may cluster on a few instances.

svg.text: OK The correct way: sum the histogram buckets, then compute the quantile
